title: Learning Where to Steer: Noise-Space Geometry for Efficient Offline Multi-Objective Optimization with Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38920v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline multi-objective optimization (MOO) seeks solutions with better objective trade-offs using only a fixed dataset, without querying the objectives. Diffusion models trained on such data have emerged as a promising approach, but their samples are not inherently better than the data and must be steered toward the Pareto front. Existing methods guide or condition every sampling step. We instead act on the initial noise and leave the sampling process unchanged. Across Off-MOO-Bench, we observe that the objectives, as functions of the noise, are sensitive to only a few directions. We estimate these directions once per task via a Recursive Feature Machine using function values alone, and a small cache serves every trade-off, so each candidate costs one noise displacement and one ODE solve. translated_title: 学习引导何处：面向高效离线多目标优化的生成模型噪声空间几何方法
translated_abstract: 离线多目标优化（MOO）旨在仅使用固定数据集，无需查询目标函数，就找到目标权衡更优的解。在此类数据上训练的扩散模型已成为一种有前景的方法，但其采样结果本质上并不优于原始数据，必须被引导至帕累托前沿。现有方法在采样过程的每一步都进行引导或条件化，我们则改为直接作用于初始噪声，保持采样过程本身不变。在Off-MOO-Bench基准上，我们观察到目标函数作为噪声的函数仅对少数几个方向敏感。我们通过递归特征机仅利用函数值，为每个任务一次性估计这些方向，且一个小型缓存即可服务于所有权衡，因此每个候选解只需一次噪声位移和一次ODE求解。我们证明了该位移在期望意义上能够提升学习到的标量化目标，并且通过扫描不同的权衡设置可以恢复流的可达（帕累托前沿）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种高效的离线多目标优化方法：利用递归特征机识别初始噪声中对目标函数敏感的少数关键方向，直接对扩散模型的初始噪声进行位移引导，从而免去逐步引导的开销，每个候选解仅需一次噪声位移和一次ODE求解，即可在期望上提升标量化目标并高效逼近可达帕累托前沿。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an efficient offline multi-objective optimization method that identifies a few task-relevant sensitive directions in noise space via a Recursive Feature Machine and directly steers the initial noise of diffusion models, eliminating per-step guidance so each candidate requires only one noise displacement and one ODE solve, provably improving the scalarized objective in expectation and recovering the flow's attainable Pareto front.
